title: Software fixes and unresolved faults
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on software faults, dealer or manufacturer fixes, and cases where the issue remains unresolved or ambiguously resolved.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe software, cruise-control, app, and related faults that required fixes but remained unresolved or were handled slowly.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention fixes, pending patches, or case handling without enough context to tell whether the outcome was satisfactory.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, limiting clarity about whether reported fixes fully resolved the underlying issues.
The cluster includes both concrete fault reports and vague case-management statements, so the topic is only loosely coherent in the examples provided.
Examples are insufficient to assess outcomes consistently across dealer, manufacturer, software, and app-related issues.
